 In addition, segments 11.4–13.4 share a stock verse sequence appearing verbatim or near-verbatim in *Mahāmoggallānattheragāthā* (Thag 20.1), *Raṭṭhapālattheragāthā* (Thag 16.4), and multiple poems of the *Therī-apadāna* (including those of Uppalavaṇṇā, Paṭācārā, Kuṇḍalakesā, Kisāgotamī, Dhammadinnā, and Sakulā) [DharmaNexus]. The verses are cited and explained at length in the Pali commentarial tradition, particularly within the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, and the *Apadāna-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. Cross-language alignments are also registered by DharmaNexus with the Chinese *Madhyama Āgama* (T 26) and Tibetan translations of the *Pratyutpannabuddhasamādhisūtra* (D0133) and *Mahāyānopadeśasūtra* (D0169) [DharmaNexus].
